message.content:
I added a GCC optimization attribute to force -O3 for this hot copy constructor, allowing better optimization of the vector copy loops. This can reduce the overhead of copying the values and stringIndexes vectors.

```cpp
__attribute__((optimize("O3")))
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
